notes.subject: זכרניכם
notes.rationale: 'Your remembrances/maxims' (ASV 'memorable sayings') vs KJV/JPS 'remembrances' — the wordplay with משלי argues for 'sayings'.

notes.subject: גביכם
notes.rationale: גַּב 'back/heights': ASV 'defences', YLT 'high places', JPS 'eminences' — the rounded-back picture is ambiguous.

notes.subject: לגבי ... גביכם
notes.rationale: Same root גב in both halves — 'backs of clay your backs' — a parallel echo kept by repeating bɛnenw.

translation: Aw ka hakilijagaw ye pɛri-ɲɛfɔliw de ye, aw ka bɛnenw ye kɛnɛ-bɛnenw de ye.
